nodes.text: John, reviewed your workplace equality bill. Section four needs work, but the core is solid.

moodVariations.Stressed: Reviewed your bill. Section four needs work, core is solid.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Reviewed your bill! Section four needs work, but it's solid!
moodVariations.Neutral: John, I've reviewed your workplace equality bill.

privateThoughts.text: Principled, but willing to compromise? That determines if we're allies.

nodes.text: The enforcement mechanism is too weak. Without teeth, it's symbolism. You know I'm right.

moodVariations.Stressed: Enforcement is too weak. Without teeth, it's symbolism.
moodVariations.Relaxed: The enforcement mechanism's too weak! You know I'm right!
moodVariations.Neutral: The enforcement mechanism is too weak.

publicOptions.text: Fair point. Let's discuss strengthening it.
Weak enforcement was a deliberate compromise.

nodes.text: Good. Two sponsors carrying this is better than one. Let's schedule markup session.

moodVariations.Stressed: Two sponsors is better than one. Schedule markup.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Good! Two sponsors! Let's schedule markup!

nodes.text: I understand the politics, John. But symbolism without enforcement helps no one.

moodVariations.Stressed: I understand the politics. But symbolism helps no one.
moodVariations.Relaxed: I get it! But symbolism helps no one!
moodVariations.Neutral: I understand the politics. But symbolism helps no one.

publicOptions.text: You're right. Let's find middle ground.
Not on this. Politics is the art of the possible.

nodes.text: Then we'll have to disagree. But I'll still support the bill. It's better than nothing.

moodVariations.Stressed: Then we disagree. But I'll support. Better than nothing.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Then we disagree! But I'll still support!
moodVariations.Neutral: Then we'll have to disagree. But I'll support the bill.

publicOptions.text: Respectfully disagreed, but grateful for support.

nodes.text: I'll have my staff send over amendments. Good working with you, John.
